raised: The page doesn't help decide how much share risk suits someone aged 61
Fees are averages, possibly not what the reader actually pays
Returns are before fees and tax, so actual earnings can't be told
The "123 מקור / 123 מחושב" line is confusing (calculated by whom?)
Product buttons never say "פנסיה"; unclear that קרן חדשה מקיפה/כללית are pension
Direct expenses are charged on top of the fees but not shown, which is worrying
Index funds/ETFs: fees split into fixed/variable/trustee jargon and no returns at all
The coloured tags (צוברת, מחזיקה את המניות, etc.) mean little
A third date in the footer (several different dates on the page)
Can't tell whether the fee from savings or from deposits matters more
The rings and coloured dots add nothing beyond the percentages
Didn't know the dotted-underlined numbers were clickable or what they'd show
"מט"ח" exposure unclear (good or bad?)
Unclear why the same shares track returns differ between the study fund and pension
"עוד לא דווח ההפקדה" on one row is not understood
The PF-06/PF-10 codes are not understood
No returns longer than 5 years and no worst-year/drawdown figure
No projection in shekels (e.g. what 500,000 ₪ would become)
No info on how to switch track or whether switching costs anything
Child savings and central severance sections are irrelevant and could go
Fund numbers could be shown only on demand

problems.why: The report never mentions the '?' help mark or its layout in the column heads; the only remark about the headers is that the reader didn't use the sort arrows.

raised: The page doesn't help a 61-year-old choose how much share risk to take or which track suits them
Fees shown are averages and may not be what the reader actually pays
Returns are before fees and tax, so the reader can't tell what they actually earned
The '123 מקור / 123 מחושב' legend is confusing: calculated by whom?
The product buttons never say 'pension', so the reader didn't know which products were pension funds
Direct expenses aren't shown, so the fee shown isn't the full cost, which worries the reader
Index fund and ETF fees are split into fixed/variable/trustee, which is confusing
Index funds and ETFs show no returns
The coloured tags (צוברת, מחזיקה את המניות, מס גם על שינויי המטבע) are jargon and mean little
The page gives several different dates (2025 fees, Sept 2026 data, footer 03.11.2026)
The reader can't tell whether fees from savings or fees from deposits cost more in shekels
Many tracks show 'less than 3 years' with no returns
The rings and coloured dots add nothing beyond the percentages
The dotted underlines on numbers don't look clickable, and it's unclear what clicking gives
It's unclear whether foreign-currency (מט"ח) exposure is good or bad
The same shares track has different returns in the study fund and the pension fund, with no explanation
'עוד לא דווח ההפקדה' on one row isn't understood
The codes PF-06 and PF-10 are unexplained
There are no returns longer than 5 years and no worst-year or drawdown figures
Money isn't shown as shekel outcomes (e.g. what 500,000 ₪ would become)
No information on how to switch tracks or whether switching costs anything
Would drop sections that don't apply (חיסכון לכל ילד, מרכזית לפיצויים)
Would hide the fund numbers and show them only on demand

problems.why: The report never mentions the '?' help mark in column heads or it dropping onto its own line; its header comments are only about sort arrows, which it says it didn't use.
